kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نبتهل (form VIII)
# نَبْتَهِلُ (nabtahilu) /nab.ta.hi.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِبْتَهَلَ (ibtahala)
# نَبْتَهِلَ (nabtahila) /nab.ta.hi.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِبْتَهَلَ (ibtahala)
# نَبْتَهِلْ (nabtahil) /nab.ta.hil/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِبْتَهَلَ (ibtahala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
